cases.title: Exact real CSV ingestion and round trip
cases.exercise: Import both and export source/common shapes; assert exact rows/values, 200 stream totals per separate scope, 25 saves, 15 playlist adds, latest followers22, monthly94/active94/super1.
cases.expected: 2004 rows and 9018 metrics, exact dates/values, no artist+recording double count

cases.title: Replay, rename, overlap and conflict revisions
cases.exercise: Repeat and rename import, add overlapping/new day, preview corrected value; reject unapproved conflict then explicitly approve revision.
cases.expected: No duplicate facts; atomic rollback; immutable approved correction; original bytes unchanged

cases.title: Invalid and stale import protection
cases.exercise: Wrong header, blank/negative/fractional/oversize count, duplicate/invalid date, stale mapping/policy/preview and failed commit.
cases.expected: No invalid/partial facts; actionable errors; failed preview cannot commit

cases.title: Import contribution undo
cases.exercise: Two imports independently support same value, undo each in sequence; then undo a revision batch.
cases.expected: Surviving contribution retained, active version reconciled, only affected evidence invalidated

cases.title: Identity and object relationships
cases.exercise: Map artist and provisional recording; verify explicit track/date; release membership and wrong event/recording link.
cases.expected: Filename is not identity, unresolved mapping visible, scope mismatch rejected

cases.title: Campaign-first outcomes and deduplication
cases.exercise: Create release/growth/show; link shared account outcome to two campaigns; inspect aggregate report.
cases.expected: One outcome contract and one activity identity, counted once, no causal campaign attribution

cases.title: Metric algebra and coverage
cases.exercise: Flow/stock/cumulative/unique/nested/ratio cases; missing baseline/dates, partial windows, refunds.
cases.expected: Compatible sums/latest/differences only, null differs from zero, Unknown/Partial visible

cases.title: Execution clock and terminal states
cases.exercise: 5pm before/after, all-day midnight, future complete, skip/cancel reason, reopen, paused campaign.
cases.expected: Correct derived states, actual separate, immutable execution history, no future completion

cases.title: Completion versus outcome
cases.exercise: Complete activity, then ingest a real scoped result and refresh outcome.
cases.expected: Completion alone changes no metrics; compatible observation updates progress

cases.title: Optimistic revision and idempotent mutations
cases.exercise: Double approval/commit/execution and concurrent stale requests.
cases.expected: One atomic result, stale write rejected, no lost edit or double count

cases.title: Local persistence and restart
cases.exercise: Save campaign/import/decision, restart app/worker, reload UI; keep unsaved draft separate.
cases.expected: Committed state survives, no seeded fictional metrics, client is not second truth

cases.title: Fixed Evidence tabs
cases.exercise: Switch Findings/data/review, drill into observation/source, Back/browser history.
cases.expected: One stable tablist/order/URLs; filters/selection preserved; no alternate taxonomy

cases.title: Nested dialog navigation
cases.exercise: Activity→Why→source→Back; enter unsaved values, expand details, scroll; save mutation then return.
cases.expected: Conventional top back nav; draft/scroll/focus restored; mutated domain state re-fetched

cases.title: Own Meta capability proof
cases.exercise: Pin route/API/scopes/account; fetch media/metrics twice; inspect timestamps and optional availability buckets.
cases.expected: Sanitised capability report, actual supported fields/coverage/zone; unavailable is not a pass

cases.title: Collector error and cursor recovery
cases.fixture: mock provider plus live read smoke
cases.exercise: Pagination, partial permission,429/retry, expired/revoked token, schema change, deletion, crash/replay.
cases.expected: No duplicated/lost committed cursor, safe backoff/health/leases, gaps not invented

cases.title: Comparable evidence and source lineage
cases.exercise: Same metric/age/context/source; reject public reach/private stream substitution, future cutoff, restricted inputs.
cases.expected: Reproducible finding resolves exact versions/row/source/purpose and reports sample/limits

cases.title: Reviewed context and identity invalidation
cases.fixture: permitted captions plus synthetic ambiguous cases
cases.exercise: Confirm/correct/leave unknown multilabel/context/entity; exclude peer after a draft exists.
cases.expected: Raw text unchanged, versions added, affected proposals stale, approved work not silently removed

cases.title: Temporal data limitations
cases.fixture: synthetic and actual shape if supported
cases.exercise: Unknown offset, hourly-only bucket, unrelated demographics, lifetime vs7day, real publication vs planned.
cases.expected: No guessed timezone/day matrix/segment join; no false comparable-age results

cases.title: Peer relevance and inspiration
cases.exercise: Verify/pin/include/exclude peer; filter reference by purpose/phase/format; attach/save idempotently.
cases.expected: Unresolved/excluded peer not recommended, public/private limits visible, preference not outcome

cases.title: Pre-save and ticket scope/reporting
cases.exercise: Map release/event, click vs presave vssave, net tickets/refunds, cumulative snapshots repeated.
cases.expected: Source needed when absent, no fabricated automatic provider, snapshots not summed

cases.title: Evidence-backed generation and abstention
cases.exercise: Release/growth/show draft, no evidence, unavailable assets/channels/list, restricted bundle and fabricated citation.
cases.expected: Only eligible supported tactics or explicit operational/manual work, no invented evidence

cases.title: Constrained explainable scheduling
cases.exercise: Harddates,phase,assets,blackout,shared labour/content caps,DST; manual time edit; new timing data.
cases.expected: Feasible reproducible window/rationale or fallback; approved times fixed; protocol flagged on edit

cases.title: Proposal review, diff and adaptation
cases.exercise: New mature result/missed work/constraints → diff; accept/modify/reject; retry and stale snapshot.
cases.expected: User decision only, atomic revision-checked apply, no silent change or duplicate churn

cases.title: Experiment lifecycle and learning
cases.exercise: Draft/approve/run linked activities, move test, await compatible window, inconclusive review.
cases.expected: Frozen protocol/version, no duplicate work, no immature or causal claim; learning/prefs distinct

cases.title: Rendered responsive accessibility
cases.exercise: 360x640,768x1024,1440x900,812x375;200%zoom;5000-character text;keyboard/dialogs/calendar/errors.
cases.expected: No overlap/hidden actions; body scroll/focus/back usable; labelled states without colour; no mock-DOM substitute

cases.title: Source purpose enforcement
cases.exercise: Denied/unresolved collect/store/derive/infer/fit/LLM/export plus derived summary/embedding.
cases.expected: Affected operation denied transitively; no policy laundering; unaffected functions work

cases.title: Deletion and revocation
cases.exercise: Delete/revoke source, jobs/bundles/datasets/cache/model report and backup restore reconciliation.
cases.expected: Required content purged, dependents invalidated, permitted tombstones only, no resurrection

cases.title: External source traceability
cases.exercise: Drill to name/URL,unknown publication date,retrieval/extracted influence; compare capability doc vs effect evidence.
cases.expected: Traceable source, unknown date preserved, documentation does not inflate tactic support

cases.title: Offline/wake source health
cases.exercise: Sleep/missed slots/offline inference/source failure and restart leases.
cases.expected: Freshness/gaps visible, collection recovery safe, no fabricated flat trend

cases.title: Early evaluation ledger without invalid training
cases.fixture: original synthetic only while gate blocked
cases.exercise: Freeze cutoff/split/version manifest, store prospective forecast before actual, reject future features.
cases.expected: Correct as-of mechanics/baselines, Spotify use/history gates explicit, no claim of trained real model

cases.title: Daily dashboard scope and freshness
cases.exercise: Today aggregate campaigns/outcomes,trendwindow,alerts with source stale/unknown and paused plans.
cases.expected: Artist-wide labelled context, deduped outcomes, named drill-down, correct missing/gap state

cases.title: Audited semantic/synthesis benchmark
cases.exercise: Rules vs approved local candidate,validschema/spans/citations,abstention,prompt injection,resources,offline.
cases.expected: Inventory/licence/hash, task thresholds frozen; no accepted invented entity/source/policy bypass; failure fallback

cases.title: Grounded Ask and edit safety
cases.exercise: Scoped question,reset scope,unknown evidence,source citations,requested edit and injected caption.
cases.expected: Grounded reply or abstain; only uncommitted validated proposals; no tools/publish/secrets/policy bypass

cases.title: Numerical forecast release gate
cases.fixture: permitted adequate real history or explicitly blocked
cases.exercise: Predeclare criteria,rolling development,untouched final holdout,naivebaseline,coverage/bias and prospective scoring.
cases.expected: Reproducible model artifact/report only when allowed/adequate/useful; otherwise Blocked/Insufficient, no causal lift

cases.title: Backup, upgrade and local boundary
cases.exercise: Verify runtime beforeWAL, consistent backup/restore/hash/foreignkeys, migration rollback,loopback/CSRF/uploads/logs.
cases.expected: Restorable matching data/files, safe migration, no public no-login exposure or secrets; repeated at release
